purpose: Teach: 抹殺/卑劣/撃退/狙撃/弛緩/摂理/拘置/朝方

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、政敵を抹殺しようとした計画を警察、未然に阻止されましたね
lines.en: So the police managed to stop the assassination plot before it could happen.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful. Lean slightly forward. Each clause deliberate—not rushed. Patient pause before the key fact. Seeking confirmation, not challenging.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、卑劣な脅迫事件を厳しく取り締まります
lines.en: The police take threats like this very seriously. We won't tolerate extortion or intimidation.
lines.style: Formal but direct. Even cadence. Authority without coldness. Slight emphasis on the commitment—'take' and 'won't'—as if stating department policy. Professional warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察が侵入者を撃退されたんですね
lines.en: So the officers managed to turn back the intruder when they arrived.
lines.style: Quiet confirmation. Nodding rhythm in the pacing. Slightly impressed but understated. Voice settles on 'intruder' like he's piecing together what happened.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、要人の狙撃を未然に防ぎます
lines.en: We prioritize protecting important people. We caught the threat before anyone was harmed.
lines.style: Clear, measured authority. Tempo picks up slightly—efficiency in the words. Protective and certain. Not boasting, just stating fact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者の筋肉弛緩を警察、検視で確認されましたね
lines.en: And the autopsy confirmed the victim had been given something to paralyze them.
lines.style: Careful, technical tone. Slight pause before 'paralyze'—letting the severity land. Voice stays level but tighter. This is the darker piece of evidence.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、自然の摂理に反する事件には毅然と対応します
lines.en: These cases demand our full attention. We respond decisively to crimes that defy the natural order.
lines.style: Thoughtful weight to each sentence. Lean on 'defy'—it carries moral weight. Steady breathing. Almost philosophical but grounded in procedure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の拘置を警察、ご決定されたんですね
lines.en: So you've made the decision to detain the suspect.
lines.style: Acknowledging, understated. Like Ren is checking a box in the story. Calm interest. Slight nod in the rhythm—'so that's settled then.'

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、朝方の通報にも素早く対応します
lines.en: We respond fast, even to calls that come in early morning. That's the standard we hold.
lines.style: Direct, slightly proud. Confidence in the delivery—not boastful, just factual. Warm undertone suggesting reliability. Closer, more personal than the procedural tone earlier.
